exposure: Domestic and family violence presentation status
Time of arrival (business hours vs. outside business hours)
History of previous DFV-related ED attendance
outcome: Admission rates to ED short stay unit
Rates of self-discharge prior to completion of care
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 70 emergency department presentations related to domestic and family violence by individuals aged 16 years and older.
finding: Compared to non-DFV attendances, DFV presentations were associated with significantly longer ED stays, higher short stay unit admission rates, and increased rates of self-discharge prior to care completion.
